skill: Integrate n/(ax+b) by linear substitution and select the antiderivative n/a ln|ax+b|+C from five mathematical radio choices.
reasoning_steps: Identify the entire affine denominator u=ax+b.
Differentiate u and substitute dx=du/a, retaining the numerator n.
Return to x and distinguish coefficient/sign and argument distractors.
invariants: Nonzero affine slope; constant numerator; one indefinite integral.
Absolute value in logarithm and arbitrary additive constant.
Five choices, exactly one antiderivative; easy single substitution workload.
No combination of integrals or absorbing C into logarithm: those are separately identified subsequent knowledge points.
permitted_variations: Small nonzero integer numerator and signed slope; small signed intercept, slope-one and negative-slope cases.
Coefficient may be positive or negative, integral or fractional; correctness must follow n/a rather than an option position or distinctive form.
Denominator can be ax+b or b+ax; order is incidental.
Choice order, prompt wording, and signed coefficient/argument distractors may vary while retaining all observed source banks on replay.
